post.description: Adds rent-schedule rows (exact due date, exact non-negative decimal amount, lease currency) to the lease. Pre-commencement leases (draft | pending_signature) keep the unchanged behavior; ACTIVE leases accept controlled post-commencement additions (every new row carries the lease currency and the frozen database default status — no status transition is invented); expired | terminated | cancelled leases REJECT additions. The lease row is re-read and locked FOR UPDATE inside the write transaction, so a concurrent lifecycle move that commits first is honored and a new schedule can never be committed against a lease that is no longer active. Amounts follow the exact numeric(20,4) contract (values that would require rounding are rejected BEFORE any database access — never rounded or truncated). Org-scoped: requires the rental.update permission (rental.manage implied) within the landlord organization; out-of-scope identifiers answer 404 without leaking existence.

201.description: Schedules added. Returns { data: [ schedule, ... ] } — every lease schedule row (exact decimal strings end-to-end; status is the frozen database default). A rental.schedules_added audit record is written in the SAME transaction with the actor, landlord organization, lease ID, due dates, exact amounts and currency; schedule sub-resource changes carry audit only (no outbox event).

400.description: Request body validation failed (unknown/forbidden properties rejected by the validation pipe).

403.description: Authenticated but missing the required rental.update (or rental.manage) permission in the landlord organization.

404.description: LEASE_NOT_FOUND — the lease does not exist or is outside the caller scope (existence is never leaked).

409.description: LEASE_SCHEDULE_DUPLICATE — the same (lease_id, due_date) already exists (frozen UNIQUE authority; a duplicate date inside one request or a concurrent winner both map here).

422.description: Domain rejection (code-based error model): LEASE_SCHEDULE_AMOUNT_INVALID (exact non-negative numeric(20,4) contract violated, including any value that would require rounding); LEASE_SCHEDULE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH (every schedule must use the lease currency — no FX); LEASE_NOT_MUTABLE (the lease is expired | terminated | cancelled, or the locked re-read lost the race against a concurrent lifecycle move).

post.summary: Add rent schedules to a lease

put.description: Replaces the editable schedule fields (dueDate, amount) of a PRISTINE rent schedule. The currency is immutable and always remains the lease currency (it is not part of the request and the column is never written). An amendment is allowed only when ALL of the following hold: the parent lease is draft | pending_signature | active; the schedule status is exactly scheduled (pending, late, partially_paid, paid, waived and cancelled schedules are NEVER reopened or modified); paid_at is NULL; and there are ZERO rows in rent_payments — a pristine amendment must never alter a receipt, a payment amount or a reconciled schedule. Amounts follow the exact numeric(20,4) non-negative contract (values that would require rounding are rejected BEFORE any database access). Concurrency-safe: the lease row is locked FOR UPDATE first, then the schedule row FOR UPDATE (the same schedule-row lock discipline the rent-payment recording path uses), and every state invariant is re-validated under the locks — a receipt recorder and a schedule amendment serialize on the schedule row and never both commit based on stale assumptions; concurrent due-date changes resolve through the frozen UNIQUE (lease_id, due_date) with exactly one winner. A failed transaction leaves NO schedule mutation and NO audit record. Org-scoped: requires the rental.update permission (rental.manage implied) within the landlord organization; out-of-scope identifiers answer 404 without leaking existence.

200.description: Schedule amended. Returns { data: { id, leaseId, dueDate, amount, currencyCode, status, paidAt } } with exact decimal strings end-to-end and the currency unchanged. A rental.schedule_amended audit record with before/after state (due date, exact amounts, currency, status, paid_at) is written in the SAME transaction; schedule sub-resource changes carry audit only (no outbox event).

400.description: Request body validation failed (unknown/forbidden properties rejected by the validation pipe).

403.description: Authenticated but missing the required rental.update (or rental.manage) permission in the landlord organization.

404.description: LEASE_NOT_FOUND / LEASE_SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND — the lease or schedule does not exist or is outside the caller scope (existence is never leaked).

409.description: LEASE_SCHEDULE_DUPLICATE — the target (lease_id, due_date) is already taken by another schedule row (frozen UNIQUE authority; concurrent due-date changes resolve with exactly one winner); LEASE_SCHEDULE_CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION — defensive guard against a stale write under the row lock.

422.description: Domain rejection (code-based error model): LEASE_SCHEDULE_AMOUNT_INVALID (exact non-negative numeric(20,4) contract violated, including any value that would require rounding); LEASE_SCHEDULE_NOT_AMENDABLE (the parent lease is not draft | pending_signature | active, the schedule status is not exactly scheduled, paid_at is set, or recorded rent payments exist); LEASE_SCHEDULE_RANGE_INVALID (frozen CHECK amount >= 0 is the DB authority).

put.summary: Amend a pristine rent schedule (due date and amount)

delete.description: Deletes an UNPAID schedule row from a pre-commencement lease (draft | pending_signature). For an active, expired, terminated or cancelled lease this is REJECTED with 422 LEASE_NOT_MUTABLE — historical and active contractual obligations are never hard-deleted, and this milestone introduces no active-lease schedule deletion or cancellation. A schedule that already carries recorded rent payments is protected by the frozen ON DELETE RESTRICT relationship (409 LEASE_SCHEDULE_IN_USE).

200.description: Schedule removed. Returns { data: { id, leaseId, dueDate, amount, currencyCode, status, paidAt } } (the removed row snapshot). A rental.schedule_removed audit record with the before-snapshot is written in the SAME transaction.

403.description: Authenticated but missing the required rental.update (or rental.manage) permission in the landlord organization.

404.description: LEASE_NOT_FOUND / LEASE_SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND — the lease or schedule does not exist or is outside the caller scope (existence is never leaked).

409.description: LEASE_SCHEDULE_IN_USE — the schedule carries recorded rent payments (frozen ON DELETE RESTRICT authority).

422.description: LEASE_NOT_MUTABLE — the lease is active | expired | terminated | cancelled; pre-commencement deletion only.

post.description: Records an already-confirmed rent receipt against a rent schedule and reconciles the schedule in ONE transaction: the schedule status is derived from confirmed payment facts (paid when the exact paid total equals the scheduled amount, partially_paid otherwise). The API never initiates a payment-provider transaction, and submitting the request is not itself evidence that money moved (actor and facts are audited). Overpayment is REJECTED — never capped, split, refunded or absorbed (422 RENT_PAYMENT_OVERPAYMENT). Waived/cancelled schedules are never reopened by a payment (422 RENT_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_NOT_PAYABLE). Concurrency-safe: the schedule row is locked FOR UPDATE and every invariant is re-validated under the lock; a failed transaction leaves NO payment row, NO outbox event and NO audit record. Org-scoped: requires the rental.update permission (rental.manage implied) within the landlord organization; out-of-scope identifiers answer 404 without leaking existence.

201.description: Rent receipt recorded. Returns { data: { payment, schedule, paidTotal, scheduleStatusBefore } }: the payment row (exact decimal strings end-to-end, amount/currencyCode echoed back), the reconciled schedule, the exact paid total after the receipt and the schedule status before it. Errors follow the code-based error model.

400.description: Request body validation failed (unknown/forbidden properties rejected by the validation pipe).

403.description: Authenticated but missing the required rental.update (or rental.manage) permission in the landlord organization.

404.description: LEASE_NOT_FOUND / LEASE_SCHEDULE_NOT_FOUND — the lease or schedule does not exist or is outside the caller scope (existence is never leaked).

409.description: RENT_PAYMENT_DUPLICATE_EXTERNAL — the same external billing payment can never be applied twice (migration 0042 unique partial index authority); RENT_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_CONFLICT — the referenced schedule no longer exists.

422.description: Domain rejection (code-based error model): RENT_PAYMENT_AMOUNT_INVALID (exact numeric(20,4) contract violated, including any value that would require rounding); RENT_PAYMENT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH; RENT_PAYMENT_SCHEDULE_NOT_PAYABLE (waived/cancelled are never reopened); RENT_PAYMENT_OVERPAYMENT (the receipt would exceed the scheduled exact amount); external provenance chain: RENT_PAYMENT_EXTERNAL_INVALID, RENT_PAYMENT_EXTERNAL_NOT_CONFIRMED, RENT_PAYMENT_EXTERNAL_AMOUNT_MISMATCH, RENT_PAYMENT_EXTERNAL_ORDER_NOT_PAID, RENT_PAYMENT_EXTERNAL_ORDER_NOT_TENANT_OWNED, and the documented fail-closed terminal RENT_PAYMENT_EXTERNAL_PROVENANCE_UNVERIFIABLE (no rent-specific billing-order-to-lease relationship exists); RENT_PAYMENT_RECORD_FAILED.

post.summary: Record a rent payment (an already-confirmed receipt)

info.description: Karen Home — Gate 4 backend. All endpoints under /api/v1; errors follow the code-based error model.

tags.description: Rental leases, parties, schedules and lifecycle (frozen 0018 schema is the authority; no invented financial or legal rules)

dueDate.description: Exact 'YYYY-MM-DD' due date (frozen date column). Unique per lease — the frozen UNIQUE (lease_id, due_date) is the concurrency-safe duplicate authority; a duplicate date is rejected with 409 LEASE_SCHEDULE_DUPLICATE.

amount.description: Exact non-negative decimal amount as a STRING (never a JSON number). Exact numeric(20,4) contract: 1-64 characters, digits with an optional fractional part — no sign, exponent, grouping separators or whitespace; at most 16 integer digits (harmless leading zeros are stripped deterministically) and at most 4 fractional digits (maximum representable value 9999999999999999.9999). ZERO is valid (the frozen schedule CHECK is amount >= 0). A value that would require rounding when persisted (more than 4 fractional digits) or exceeds the range is rejected with 422 LEASE_SCHEDULE_AMOUNT_INVALID BEFORE anything is written — never rounded, truncated or capped. Must equal the lease currency (422 LEASE_SCHEDULE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH on mismatch; no FX conversion).

currencyCode.description: Exactly 3 characters. Must equal the lease's own currency — no FX conversion is performed. Mismatch → 422 LEASE_SCHEDULE_CURRENCY_MISMATCH.

items.description: One to 200 schedule rows to add (validated as a whole — a request with any invalid row, duplicate date or currency mismatch writes NOTHING).

dueDate.description: Exact 'YYYY-MM-DD' due date (frozen date column) REPLACING the schedule's due date. Unique per lease — the frozen UNIQUE (lease_id, due_date) is the concurrency-safe duplicate authority: amending onto a date that another schedule row (or a concurrent amendment winner) already holds is rejected with 409 LEASE_SCHEDULE_DUPLICATE — exactly one concurrent winner.

amount.description: Exact non-negative decimal amount as a STRING (never a JSON number) REPLACING the schedule amount. Exact numeric(20,4) contract: 1-64 characters, digits with an optional fractional part — no sign, exponent, grouping separators or whitespace; at most 16 integer digits (harmless leading zeros are stripped deterministically) and at most 4 fractional digits (maximum representable value 9999999999999999.9999). ZERO is valid (the frozen schedule CHECK is amount >= 0). A value that would require rounding when persisted (more than 4 fractional digits) or exceeds the range is rejected with 422 LEASE_SCHEDULE_AMOUNT_INVALID BEFORE anything is written — never rounded, truncated or capped. The currency is immutable: it is not part of this request and always remains the lease currency. Only pristine schedules can be amended (422 LEASE_SCHEDULE_NOT_AMENDABLE otherwise).

Exact positive decimal amount as a STRING (never a JSON number). Exact numeric(20,4) contract: 1-64 characters, digits with an optional fractional part — no sign, exponent, grouping separators or whitespace; at most 16 integer digits (harmless leading zeros are stripped deterministically) and at most 4 fractional digits (maximum representable value 9999999999999999.9999). A value that would require rounding when persisted (more than 4 fractional digits) or exceeds the range is rejected with 422 RENT_PAYMENT_AMOUNT_INVALID BEFORE anything is written — never rounded, truncated or capped. The same canonical exact value flows into persistence, the overpayment comparison, reconciliation totals, audit and event payloads.

currencyCode.description: Exactly 3 characters. Must equal the rent schedule's currency — no FX conversion is performed (the frozen trg_rent_payment_currency trigger stays the DB authority). Mismatch → 422 RENT_PAYMENT_CURRENCY_MISMATCH.

externalPaymentId.description: Optional UUID of a billing.payments row. NOT a supported recording path in the current implementation: the frozen billing schema establishes no rent-specific link between billing orders and rental leases, so rent-payment intent cannot be verified from repository evidence. A request carrying this field runs the provenance chain (payment exists → status succeeded → currency equal → amount exactly equal → order paid → order owned by the lease tenant) and then ALWAYS fails closed with 422 RENT_PAYMENT_EXTERNAL_PROVENANCE_UNVERIFIABLE. Omit this field to record an already-confirmed receipt manually — the supported model (documented limitation).

paidAt.description: Optional ISO-8601 date-time of the confirmed receipt (strict ISO-8601 validation). When omitted, the service/database default (now()) applies.
